name: Test of Strength
summary: In Thousand Needles, Dorn Plainstalker asks you to prove your strength. Your trial brings you against Rok'Alim the Pounder, an ancient rock elemental, and calls for pieces of his shattered form.

sections.title: Remnants of the Old Gods' Age
sections.body: Long ago, primordial elementals covered the world and served the Old Gods. When those powers were overthrown and sealed beneath the earth, the spirits lost their hold on this realm. Most faded from the physical world unless modern spellcraft bound and summoned them. A few were strong enough to remain on Azeroth without such magic. Rok'Alim the Pounder is one of them, wandering the arid canyons of Thousand Needles as an echo of that age.

sections.title: The Pounder of Thousand Needles
sections.body: The centaur clans named Rok'Alim for the deafening crashes of his stone fists against the canyon floor. Anyone who crosses his path risks being hammered into dust. Dorn Plainstalker sends initiates to face this force of raw might and prove their warrior spirit. They return with fragments of the elemental's stony heart as proof of victory.

faq.q: Where does this quest begin and end?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker offers and completes the trial at Weathered Nook, a secluded canyon camp high among the spires of Thousand Needles.

aliases: what kind of mob is rokalim
faq.answer: Rok'Alim is an ancient rock elemental who has endured in Kalimdor since the age of the Old Gods. His innate power lets him remain physically present on Azeroth without being summoned.

faq.q: Why do the centaur call him 'the Pounder'?
faq.answer: The centaur tribes call Rok'Alim the Pounder for the thunderous shockwaves his stone fists unleash when they smash anything in his path.

faq.q: Where can Rok'Alim be found in the canyon?
faq.answer: Rok'Alim wanders the northwestern stretches of Thousand Needles, usually patrolling open ground south of the main road across the canyon floor.

faq.q: What place does this quest hold in the overall trial chain?
faq.answer: This is the third trial in the chain, after the Test of Faith and the Test of Endurance. It comes before the final trial, the Test of Lore.

faq.q: Why does Dorn require an elemental to be slain instead of a beast or enemy?
faq.answer: Dorn chooses Rok'Alim because the elemental is living stone and an unyielding, primordial force. Overcoming him proves your physical strength against the raw, unbending earth itself.

angles.text: As a tauren pilgrim, you face an untamed spirit of stone in a traditional test of harmony and physical will. You show that you can endure and overcome the harshest forces of the Earth Mother.
As a shaman, you recognize Rok'Alim as a dangerous, unbound spirit of earth. His refusal to yield disturbs the local balance of spirits.
As a member of the Horde, you earn the respect of the Thunder Bluff elders by completing the Weathered Nook rites. You build your reputation across Kalimdor.
